Highly Detailed 3D Moon Model for Precision Printing

Our Moon 3D STL model comes with various levels of detail, allowing you to choose the version that best suits your needs, from hobby projects to professional displays. Using advanced printing technology, you can achieve a smooth and precise replica of the Moon, perfect for astronomy lovers and educational purposes.

What's Included in the Moon STL Archive?

The downloadable archive includes six separate files in STL format, each offering different levels of detail and parts for a customizable printing experience:
  • Whole moon model (Level of detail 4) – 375 MB
  • Upper part of the moon (Level of detail 4) – 188 MB
  • Lower part of the moon (Level of detail 4) – 188 MB
  • Whole moon model (Level of detail 5) – 1.46 GB
  • Upper part of the moon (Level of detail 5) – 760 MB
  • Lower part of the moon (Level of detail 5) – 760 MB

Perfect for Spacecraft Design and Educational Use

This 3D printable moon model is an ideal addition for those interested in spacecraft design or exploring the phases of the Moon. It's not just a display piece; it's a versatile model for classroom demonstrations, space art projects, or even as a functional part of your DIY projects related to NASA and astronomy.

Why Choose Our Moon STL Model?

  • Detailed lunar surface: Get a realistic representation of the Moon’s craters and texture.
  • Multiple file options: Choose the file that matches your project’s scale and level of detail.
  • Instant download: Get started immediately with easy-to-use STL files for all 3D printers.
